items.title: Reject task titles longer than 200 characters with a clear error
done_when: The domain rule rejects titles over 200 characters, covered by a unit test
The create and update request schemas reject titles over 200 characters, covered by unit tests
The API rejection tells the caller the title is too long
items.question: Should a too-long title get its own error message, instead of the generic 'Input is invalid'?
items.owner_note: Yes, and keep the messages short.

items.title: Show done and remaining task counts for a list
done_when: The task page view model carries done and remaining counts for the whole list, not just the loaded page
Unit tests cover the counts in the view model and the use case
The dashboard shows the counts and keeps them correct after adding, completing and deleting tasks
Typecheck, lint and unit tests pass
left: The dashboard shows the counts and keeps them correct after adding, completing and deleting tasks: Built and reviewed (dashboard shows 'N done · M remaining' under the list name and adjusts after add, status change and delete), and e2e assertions were added to e2e/core-journey.spec.ts, but nobody has seen it run: the dashboard and the Postgres and e2e suites need Docker, which could not be started unattended. Run pnpm test:integration and the core e2e journey once Docker is up.

items.title: Clear completed tasks from a list
done_when: The developer has chosen between permanent delete and archive
A list offers a Clear completed action that does what was chosen
items.question: Should 'Clear completed' delete the done tasks for good, or archive them?

items.title: Screenshot of the dashboard showing done and remaining counts
done_when: A screenshot of the real running dashboard showing the counts is saved in the evidence folder
